description: Modular wall-mounted toothbrush holder system with dovetail joints, clips, a cap-up toothpaste hanger, and a deep drip tray with brush-head drying spikes and support spikes that keep parked brushes off the tray floor.
printing_notes: The tray's two corner head pegs and two support spikes all print vertically with no supports. The support spikes taper to a fine point — slow the last few layers, or print with a second object on the plate, so each tip has time to cool.

Toothpaste hanger.stl slides onto the same backplate rail as Toothpaste clip.stl — print one or the other, not both. It prints dovetail-face-down with the two prongs pointing up, no supports; slow the perimeters on the prongs, they are slender 5 x 4 mm columns.

The fork is sized for a cap measuring 27.4 mm at its narrowest waist and 33.7 mm at its widest (caliper-measured, issue #484). Measure your own cap and re-render from the customizer with both cap_neck_d and cap_flange_d set to it — the flange must stay meaningfully wider than the neck or the tube has nothing to hang from. prong_t must be no thicker than the groove between the cap's flange and the tube shoulder.
